name: juicebot
description: AI control of the Juicebox Hi-C contact-map viewer: search ENCODE/4DN, load maps and tracks, navigate loci, compare panels, share sessions. Connects to the Aiden Lab's hosted MCP server; nothing runs locally.

interface.longDescription: Drive the Juicebox Hi-C contact-map viewer by typing plain requests: search ENCODE and 4DN Hi-C maps, load maps and tracks, navigate to genes and loci, compare panels, and share sessions. The map opens in a browser tab that must stay open while you work. Connects to the Aiden Lab's hosted MCP server; no account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Load the GM12878 Hi-C map and go to the HOXA cluster.
Go to MYC and add the gene track.
Create a link I can share showing this view.
